statement: Among SUID cases, infants who spent time in the hospital overnight after birth are more likely to have been born preterm compared to those who did not.
rationale: The design uses a case-only approach to compare hospital stay status and gestational age among SUID cases. It does not estimate incidence or risk but compares proportions within the case series.
prior_art: None in the inputs; existing claims focus on developmental windows, bed sharing, and maternal smoking but do not address hospital stays and gestational age at birth.
cannot_establish: incidence, risk estimates, or causation due to lack of denominator source and uncontrolled confounding factors.
